note_write_message: note a message to stderr with kind 'note' for informational output
warning_write_message: warning a message to stderr with kind 'warning' for non-failing issues
error_write_message: error a message to stderr with kind 'error' for error reporting
fatal_exit_program: fatal a message to stderr and exit the program with status 1
write_message_format_output: write a formatted message to stderr with a given kind and message string
